sources.name: GaneshaSpeaks
sources.text: Ganesha sees you taking a day off from your work and immersing your self in domestic activities. A lot of time will be spent blissfully with your family folk chatting away or doing this and that. The idea of getting your interiors redone and give your house a new look will surely occur to you. Instead of doing things on your own, it is very likely you will engage a professional for the job.

sources.name: Horoscope.com
sources.text: Perhaps you feel cheated when the object of your desire doesn't give you complete attention at all times. The fundamental security of your being is your responsibility, not someone else's. Find a way to incorporate your dreams into the dreams of others instead of always working toward goals at opposite sides of the spectrum.

sources.name: Astrology.com
sources.text: Sudden changes to your environment might feel exciting at first, but could ultimately throw you off balance. Take time to catch your breath and steady your emotions while Saturn activates. Solitude will be the key to reclaiming peace, so don't hesitate to silence your phone before hiding away. Your productivity spikes when the Sun and Luna align this afternoon, and there won't be much that can stop you once you get moving.

sources.name: AstroSage
sources.text: Some unavoidable circumstances can give you some uneasiness. But you must try to keep your poise and should not react immediately to tackle the situation. This is the perfect day to attract the attention of others without doing much on your side. Think twice before you take on any new project. If you are married and have children, then they can complain to you regarding you not being able to give them ample time. Your life looks really wonderful in terms of marriage today.

readings.text: Bravo! You will win your challenge today. You will get devoted to work throughout the day. Your focus and sincerity will accomplish many difficult tasks and eventually fetch appreciation from colleagues and boss. As a result, you may receive some important gains, feels Ganesha.

A four-week trend begins today that will have a major effect on your career, so it is important to be mindful of this whether you are at work or not. For the next four weeks, there will be obstacles, and a major change in direction is necessary.

Instead of doing things on your own, it is very likely you will engage a professional for the job.
Find a way to incorporate your dreams into the dreams of others instead of always working toward goals at opposite sides of the spectrum.
Think twice before you take on any new project.

readings.text: Ganesha advises that it is better to think twice before spending money. You should not take decisions impulsively and should see to it that money is spent in right direction at the right time.

You may need to reconsider recent financial plans. Your head is full of all kinds of amazingly creative ideas. If you're a writer, journalist, or publisher, this is a great time to be you. But you need to use these gifts in a responsible way. Make sure you're saving your money with a reliable company.

bits.t: A lot of time will be spent blissfully with your family folk chatting away or doing this and that.

readings.text: There are higher chances of you getting closer to people you like as your communication will be very smooth with them today. All these things can impact your health positively. This is not a good day for taking heavy workload, feels Ganesha.

If there is a great weight of emotional energy surrounding you right now be reassured to know that with today's position of the planets this is to be expected! There's not much you can do to alter the effect of this aspect. You will want to stay focused on your exercise regimen, or create one at this time, in order to avoid feeling depressed. A healthy diet with lots of greens is good for you. Your energy will be greatly enhanced by drinking plenty of water as well.

lucky.remedy: Health will be good by giving flag/banner at any religious place.

extras.title: Bonus
extras.text: Accepting the way things are, instead of the way you want them to be, is wise today.
